# CkLog

**Purpose:** Logging infrastructure. Defines `FCk_LogCategory`, the log-category registry, per-module log function generation macros, and editor notification helpers. Every other module that logs goes through CkLog.

**Depends on:** `CkSettings`, `CkThirdParty`.
**Used by:** All ~85 CkFoundation modules (directly or via CkCore's pass-through `CkCore/Log/CkLog.h`).

---

## Defining a module log

Each module defines its own log functions by wrapping the CkLog macro inside a namespace:

```cpp
// In CkAudio/CkAudioLog.h (example structure):
namespace ck::audio
{
    // Generated by the macro (see CkLog_Utils.h for the macro definition):
    CKAUDIO_API auto Verbose    (const FString& InMessage) -> void;
    CKAUDIO_API auto VeryVerbose(const FString& InMessage) -> void;
    CKAUDIO_API auto Warning    (const FString& InMessage) -> void;
    CKAUDIO_API auto Error      (const FString& InMessage) -> void;
    CKAUDIO_API auto Display    (const FString& InMessage) -> void;
}
```

Then call sites use:
```cpp
ck::audio::Verbose(TEXT("Starting track [{}]"), TrackName);
ck::audio::Warning(TEXT("Null component for entity [{}]"), Handle);
```

The macro-generated functions accept already-formatted `FString`s. Format first with `ck::Format_UE(...)` if you need argument substitution, or pass the fmt-style string directly — the module log macros handle formatting internally.

---

## `FCk_LogCategory`

A typed log-category reference — wraps `FName` for the category, validated by `IsValid()`. Used by runtime systems that need to dynamically select a log category (editor tooling, console commands).

```cpp
// Introspection:
auto AllCategories = ck::log::Get_AllRegisteredCategories(); // TArray<FName>
auto& LogMap = ck::log::Get_LogMap();                        // name → callable
```

---

## Editor notifications

`CkLog_Utils.h` also exposes slate notification helpers (`SNotificationList`) for editor-time feedback. Gate these under `WITH_EDITOR`.

---

## Log levels

| Level | When to use |
|---|---|
| `VeryVerbose` | Frame-level spew (use sparingly; filtered out by default) |
| `Verbose` | Per-request or per-event diagnostics |
| `Display` | User-facing messages (appear in screen log) |
| `Warning` | Recoverable unexpected state |
| `Error` | Unrecoverable state (operation cancelled/failed) |
| `Fatal` | Crash-triggering — avoid; prefer `CK_ENSURE` + early return |

---

## Anti-patterns

1. Don't use UE's `UE_LOG` directly in CkFoundation modules. The module-specific namespace functions ensure the correct log category and route through the editor notification system.
2. Don't log at `VeryVerbose` in hot paths without a compile-time guard — even a no-op call to the formatter has cost.
3. Don't use `Fatal` where `CK_TRIGGER_ENSURE` + return would do. Fatal crashes without the per-site silencing benefit of the Ensure system.
